rationale: Both candidates independently caught the same tangential issue to the ground truth (PR description claims trust_remote_code=True but it's absent from the diff/code), giving them equal partial recall of the one real ground-truth concern, though neither made the actionable dependency-bound recommendation Codex gave. X padded its review with weaker findings (missing docstrings, missing cache test) and one factually wrong claim — `except Exception` does not catch KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit since those inherit from BaseException, not Exception — which hurts its precision. Y's two findings (description mismatch, lock scope serializing FA2/FA3 loads) are both technically correct, well-grounded, and clearly actionable with file/line references.
